description: Move one of your library playlists into a playlist folder, or back to the top level ("root"). Checks the folder exists and verifies the playlist appears in it. Uses Apple's web-player API (unofficial; needs APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_USER_TOKEN).

folderId.description: Destination folder id (p.… from apple_music_list_folders), or "root" for the top level.

name: apple_music_move_playlist
title: Move an Apple Music playlist into a folder
